steps.en: Required fields are checked when moving to the review page
steps.id: Field wajib dicek saat pindah ke halaman review

steps.en: The user is stopped on the form until required fields are valid
steps.id: User tertahan di form sampai field wajib valid

steps.en: Submit stays off until the declaration is ticked
steps.id: Submit tetap mati sampai deklarasi dicentang

steps.en: The system also rejects the submission if required fields are empty
steps.id: Sistem juga menolak submission bila field wajib kosong
